messages:
Maria Lopez: Quick sync — NimbleCompute just uploaded the final perf/W sweep results. Need to pick next kernel-tune experiments and agree on what we include in the joint benchmark appendix. @Kenji can you take first pass on numbers?

BenchBot: automated run complete for run-id 1960002468. configs: 12. best perf/W (tokens/s/W): config-7 -> 24.3, config-4 -> 22.8. notes: config-7 increases microkernel unroll, 9% p95 latency regression. logs -> s3://redwood-bench/nimble/1960002468/summary.json

Kenji Tanaka: Nice. Where are the raw power traces? are those PDU-level or per-GPU? Any unexpected throttles?

Eli Nakamura (NimbleCompute): PDU-average over 30s windows, per-run CSVs in that s3 path. We also uploaded a short firmware diff (fw-3.2.1 -> fw-3.2.3) that enabled a different memory governor that helped perf/W. Invited maria+kenji to the kernel repo (`git://nimble/bench-kernels`).

Alex Reilly: Trying to repro locally — sharing a minimal repro command so envs match:```./run_bench --model t5-11b --batch 4 --seq 512 --quant q4_0 --kernels kernel_setB --power-sample 30 --outdir ./out/nimble/1960002468```Make sure CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES ordering matches partner baseline.

Kenji Tanaka: Thanks. A couple quick asks: (1) can we get the exact kernel diffs (not just compiled blobs)? (2) definition check — perf/W = tokens/s divided by steady-state watts (30s average) from PDU, correct?

Eli Nakamura (NimbleCompute): Correct on perf/W. Kernel diffs are in `kernels/diffs/1960002468/` in the repo. I'll share read access for maria, kenji, alex. Note: the thermal limit was set to 260W per node for these runs.

Maria Lopez: Action items: - Kenji to attempt reproduction on Redwood-dedicated by EOD Wed - Alex to run latency profile (p50/p95/p99) and attach plots - Priya to coordinate partner PR window and embargo - schedule sync Thurs 11:00 PT to align on public messaging :calendar:

Priya Patel: Got it — will confirm PR window. @Eli any constraints from Nimble on announcement timing?

Eli Nakamura (NimbleCompute): Prefer no external press until kernel diffs merged into main (target Fri). Internal sync on Thurs works for us.

BenchBot: reminder: reproduction run queued on Redwood-dedicated at 1960003000.

Alex Reilly: If Kenji can't match numbers, next step is kernel bisect + perf harness. I'll prep a bisect script and drop it in `./tools/bisect.sh` here by tomorrow.

Kenji Tanaka: Sounds good. I'll post results (raw CSV + pwr traces) in this thread once the run finishes. :thumbsup:

Maria Lopez: Thanks everyone — syncing Thurs. If anyone needs access to the repo or S3 path ping me and I'll escalate.
